notes.title: 1.5.7 : NPC Skin Changes
notes.notes:
1.5.7 : NPC Skin Changes

Changed a number of NPC models.

notes.title: 1.5.5.3 : Non DLSS Graphics Card changes
notes.notes:
1.5.5.3 : Non RTX (DLSS) Graphics Card changes

Changed setup for Non RTX (DLSS) cards . 
Noticed a few Players crashing in some places without RTX cards, so this fixes a possible shader error.
Dynamic Resolution Scaling set to off by default, can use TAA by changing in-game settings.

notes.title: 1.5.5.2 : Fixed Disappearing Rocks + Version Checks
notes.notes:
1.5.5.2 : Fixed Disappearing Rocks

Fixed some rocks that disappeared if you went into the outer floor of the orcazelos Desert.

notes.title: 1.5.4.7 : Hotfix for Qrozier!
notes.notes:
1.5.4.7 : Hotfix for Qrozier!

Just equipping this Legendary Healing Item could cause a crash in some circumstances.

Should not cause any more Crashes !

notes.title: 1.5.4.4 : Hotfix Weapon FX
notes.notes:
1.5.4.4 : Hotfix Weapon FX

Last night's update removed weapon FX (sword slash , ranged, specials).

This may have caused Player.log file bloating and slowed down play.

notes.title: 1.5.4.3 : Npc Camp Recruitment Changes
notes.notes:
1.5.4.3 : Npc Camp Recruitment Changes

as before semi clears will increase rarity of reinforcements, but not by as much as full clears.

where mythic mobs are available the higher rarity chances will increase until mythic spawns , and following that mythics death , the camp will reset to all common. Clearing the camp will repeat the cycle.

Also fixed non visible right hand weapons.

notes.title: 1.5.4.2 : experience changes
notes.notes:
stun now smoother adjustment x0 at 50 damage up to 2x at 250+ damage.

experience awarded now far more reflective of time to kill based on npc rarity;

cubitz and essence of experience number popups now marked with "cbz" and "eoe"

various additions to the crafting ingredients and recipes.

another big download, hopefully to bring down the size of future updates.

notes.title: 1.5.3.3 : hotfix for investigation in desert quest
notes.notes:
1.5.3.3 : hotfix for investigation in desert quest

this quest now ends partway through with the new dlc needed to complete.

this was causing players to hang or crash after investigating the well.

this now fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.5 Released.
notes.notes:
A fixed damage system has been introduced, based on the level and rarity of the armor + weaponry involved. 

No more RNG in damage numbers.

notes.notes:
